name: ChatSpark
author: Contempo Creative Inc.

sections.description:
Meet your always-on Conversational AI Agent trained on your data, ready to engage across channels. Whether it’s your website, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, or Slack, ChatSpark delivers intelligent, 24/7 customer service that scales with your business.

The ChatSpark plugin makes it easy for customers to embed their AI Agent directly on their WordPress site. Just install the plugin, enter your AI Agent ID, and you’re live—no code, no hassle.

Note: A ChatSpark account and an active subscription are required to obtain an AI Agent ID and use this plugin. Visit https://chatspark.io to sign up and explore pricing plans.

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on the external ChatSpark.io service to function. It powers the AI Agent embedded on your site, enabling seamless automated interactions with your visitors. All data exchanged between your site and ChatSpark.io is secured and used solely to facilitate intelligent, real-time engagement.

By using this plugin, you agree to the following:

  • ChatSpark Terms of Service: https://chatspark.io/terms-and-conditions
  • ChatSpark Privacy Policy: https://chatspark.io/privacy-policy

Please ensure you comply with data handling regulations in your region when using third-party AI services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire chatspark folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. After activation, you’ll see a menu named “ChatSpark” in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Click it, enter your AI Agent ID, and save the changes.
  5. Your AI Agent will now be embedded and active on your site.
sections.faq:
Where can I find my ChatSpark AI Agent ID?

Log into https://chatspark.io/login, go to “My AI Agents,” find the one you want to use, and copy its ID.
